visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a large, brightly lit exhibition hall with a massive screen displaying 'COMPUTEX TAIPEI 2025'. A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless top with a black mesh overlay and a white tote bag, stands in the foreground smiling. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of the woman inside the exhibition area, where she enthusiastically raises her fists near a green and black striped wall. Many people in business casual attire walk in the background under bright studio-style lighting. (3) A high-angle shot shows a large triangular overhead structure branded 'REPUBLIC OF GAMERS' with the ROG logo. Stage lights are visible on the ceiling rafters. (4) The host runs through a crowded walkway, waving her hand and looking back at the camera. The background is filled with blurred exhibition booths and attendees. (5) She stops at a display featuring an ROG logo wall and then moves to a teal-colored pedestal showcasing a Hatsune Miku branded gaming setup, including a monitor with anime graphics, a matching keyboard, and headphones. (6) Close-up shots of two different ROG Strix gaming laptops are shown; one features a colorful RGB keyboard and a desktop wallpaper with a car, while the other shows a similar high-tech design. (7) The host stands next to a small, spherical robot named OMNI with a digital face and glowing yellow ears. She gestures toward it and leans in to speak into a microphone on a boom arm. (8) The camera captures the robot's screen changing to show a white heart icon. The host reacts with an exaggerated expression of surprise and delight, covering her mouth with her hands. (9) She holds up a pair of black Air Vision M1 smart glasses, showing them to the camera before putting them on. She then holds a gaming controller connected to a smartphone while looking through the glasses. (10) Transitioning to a laptop demo, the screen shows a vibrant interface with text about AI styling. The host points to the screen and then dances in front of a large LED wall that flickers with green lightning graphics. (11) In the final phase, she stands back at the ROG booth, holding a small black device (possibly an ROG phone or accessory), waving and smiling energetically to the camera as she concludes her tour.
